jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

  
  

**Position Summary**

  

The Clinical Implementation Specialist is responsible for providing external business clients with technical support with the implementation of their application software, software solutions, and hardware. The Clinical Implementation Specialist is also responsible for providing software configuration against defined user requirements and specifications. The Implementation Specialist works in partnership with the development team to ensure all application software and software solutions are implemented to meet business client and project expectations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

  

The essential duties and responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to the following:

* Work directly with clients as a clinical expert and an essential member of the project team

* Apply clinical knowledge and expertise to guide clients in the necessary system clinical workflow to satisfy and possibly exceed current requirements

* Use knowledge of clinical standards to recommend appropriate system set-up to clients

* Apply technical and operational knowledge and expertise to perform software and integration testing of implemented software systems and solutions

* Resolve identified issues requiring changes to implemented software applications and solutions

* Develop scripts (test cases) for newly implemented software applications and solutions

* Work closely with the development team in gathering and reviewing business client feedback and assist in writing user requirement documents

* Work closely with engineering resources to define requirements for product changes

* Contribute to the development of and tracking against project plans around project progress, milestones and targeted implementation date

* Identify risks that could impact the business client’s stated business objectives and develop risk mitigation plans to manage the risk with the development and implementation teams

* Ensure all business client communication and documentation is recorded in appropriate repositories to maintain product documentation

* Test and troubleshoot final system implementations

* Provide training and end-user support during and after the implementation process

Other duties and/or projects as assigned

  
  

### **Requirements**

  
  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Certification in area of clinical expertise, such as LCSW, LMSW, LMHC, LPN, and others.
* Bachelor’s degree that supports clinical expertise
* 5 years professional work experience in a behavioral healthcare environment, including in-depth experience using an EHR platform
* Strong working knowledge of Information Technology, software solutions, and software management systems
Ability to travel up to 25% as needed  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Master's degree in a Clinical Profession  

  

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Demonstrated ability to use effective and results-oriented problem solving and critical thinking skills; strong troubleshooting ability
* Demonstrated ability to use strong analytical skills
* Effective interpersonal and people skills
* Ability to juggle multiple tasks, establish and manage competing priorities, work independently and be proactive and perform effectively under
* pressure
* Ability to anticipate issues and risk and work proactively to develop alternatives to meet project goals and objectives
* Strong and effective communication skills (verbal and written)
* Pays very close attention to detail
Ability to work independently and within a team environment  

  
  

### **Benefits**

  
  

**Fully Remote Workforce**

As a virtual-first organization, we can attract the best talent no matter where we all live. This allows for added flexibility and a schedule that works for you.

  

**Employee Recognition**

Team members can reward each other with points to celebrate everyday wins and going above and beyond. It’s our way of saying “nice job” in a way that really sticks.

  

**Financial Incentives**

Employees can benefit financially through the company’s success, referring top talent, and performance-based bonuses.

  
  

**Salary**: $85,000 - $100,000

We are not able to offer visa sponsorships at this time.

**Title: Implementation Specialist**

**Location: Remote US**

**Reports To: Senior VP of Production**

**Compensation: $65,000 - 70,000 base salary, plus benefits and equity**

**About Brilliant:**

Brilliant is an innovative branded products and corporate gifting company. Built with our clients in mind and a focus on creativity and technology, Brilliant curates, produces, and helps companies distribute memorable branded merchandise and custom products. Whether it's newsworthy press kits, welcome gifts for new employees, merchandise sets to promote a product launch, or giveaways people love - our team of retail trend experts and designers work together to produce impactful products that bring brands to life.

As a full-service partner, we offer product concepting, sourcing, design, custom packaging, merch collections, company stores, touchpoint gifting, warehousing, fulfillment and distribution.

Technology is part of our DNA. Our proprietary systems gives clients instantaneous access to important information and tools, including real-time inventory data, on-demand fulfillment services, and convenient 3rd party system integrations, such as Salesforce, Workday, and Zapier - reducing busy work and creating a seamless experience for gift givers and receivers.

  

### **What You'll Do:**

The Implementation Specialist plays a key role in delivering successful software implementations for our clients, serving as the execution owner from kickoff through launch. This role is responsible for translating client needs into well-planned, well-run implementations while coordinating closely with internal teams such as Sales, Account Management, Product, Engineering and Design.

You'll need to be comfortable leading client-facing implementation calls, managing timelines and deliverables, and ensuring that both software configuration and client-facing assets are completed accurately and on time. The Implementation Specialist balances structured, long-term implementation work with the ability to respond to time-sensitive issues as they arise.

This position involves hands-on software setup and ongoing optimization, often alongside manual service workflows, with an expectation of identifying patterns, gaps, and improvement opportunities to share with Brilliant's Product team. The role collaborates closely across teams and works directly with clients to resolve issues, clarify requirements, and support adoption.

While the role does not require coding, it does require comfort with technical fundamentals such as HTML, CSS, third party APIs and our integrations in order to support launches and troubleshooting, configuration, and client guidance. Overall, the Implementation Specialist is a highly collaborative, execution-focused role that contributes directly to the quality, consistency, and scalability of client software implementations.

### **End-to-End Software Implementation Leadership**

* Lead client software implementations from kickoff through launch, serving as the primary owner of execution and delivery.
* Run implementation calls with clients, setting clear agendas, managing action items, and keeping projects moving forward.
* Translate client goals and requirements into clear implementation plans, timelines, and configuration decisions.
* Partner with Account Management to ensure implementations align with broader client objectives and long-term account success.
* Coordinate design asset needs with our design team, or occasionally our client's creative teams, to complete the final leg of implementations.
* Project management of integration and automation roll outs for clients with our platform engineering team and product management teams.
* Gather, document, and communicate client asset requirements, feedback, and revision requests.

**Software Setup & Lifecycle Management**

* Manage the setup and configuration of Brilliant's software tools, including our automations and integrations, for individual clients and projects.
* Test configurations prior to launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, and quality.
* Troubleshoot issues and adjust setups as needed throughout the client lifecycle.
* Support ongoing optimization of client implementations post-launch.
* Coordinate cross-functional resources (Design, Integrations, Product, Client Success, and technical teams) to ensure on-time, high-quality launches.
* Track implementation progress, risks, and dependencies, proactively addressing blockers.  
  Help improve implementation workflows, templates, and best practices over time.

**Documentation, Training & Enablement**

* Partner with Product Management to understand new releases and feature updates.
* Contribute to internal documentation and training materials to support team adoption and consistency.
* Guide clients through software adoption during and after implementation, ensuring confidence and clarity for their follow up questions and needs that are beyond the expertise of our Account Management team members.

### **Feedback & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify recurring client challenges, usability issues, and workflow friction.
* Share structured feedback and insights with Product and Engineering teams to inform future improvements and roadmap decisions.
* Provide input on early concepts or changes based on hands-on implementation experience.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 2+ years of experience in software implementation, technical customer support, product specialist, business analyst, or a similar role.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to think analytically in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, especially in client-facing settings.
* Customer-first mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality implementation experiences.
* Comfort learning and navigating new software platforms quickly.
* Experience with CRM tools and support ticketing systems.
* Basic proficiency with HTML and CSS (no coding required; familiarity for troubleshooting templates and small adjustments).
* General familiarity with APIs and technical concepts sufficient to support describing integration workflows and answering basic client questions and troubleshooting issues

### **Why Join Us**

**Brilliant Perks & Benefits**: We're pleased to offer our full-time teammates Medical, Dental, & Vision benefits in addition to perks like flexible PTO, paid company holidays, and a work from home stipend for new hires!
  
  
**Impact at scale**: Work with top brands and support thousands of personalized gifting experiences annually

**Cutting-edge tech stack**: By building our technology in-house as well as hosting our own fulfillment center, we blend curated technology and powerful systems to provide curated offerings, fulfillment workflows, and automation

**Hands-on collaboration**: Join a team that's passionate about providing high quality, curated offerings, that enhance brand and employee loyalty, while working cross-functionally across the organization.

**Global footprint**: Support clients across 180+ countries and impact the full giftee journey

**Growth & innovation**: Contribute to developing new platform capabilities and workflow possibilities

The position will work within cross-functional project teams to build and deliver innovative print and/or digital course materials for the professional and higher education markets. The Implementation Specialist may work with proprietary course builder software, established content development software, content management systems and learning management systems. This position may also contribute to the support and maintenance requests to meet the team’s required service level contracts with clients.

* Develops and updates course content materials according to the specifications, standards, and guidelines of the project with oversight from a senior level position.
* Formats content per project design specifications.
* Maintains course and academic content in established storage systems and databases using Institutional protocols, processes and procedures.

Effectively operates in a team environment, collaborating with Course Development team members during course development.  

* May prepare PDF files and deliverables for print vendors, internal stakeholders, and partners as needed.
* Actively participates on project teams in assisting with planning, scheduling, and problem solving.

Effectively utilizes appropriate technology such as authoring tools, production software, content management system, digital asset system, learning management system and other technical tools/software applications used within the organization as required.  

* Completes other duties as assigned.

**Senior Implementation Manager**

Lead complex customer implementations, align stakeholders, and turn technical deployments into meaningful business outcomes.

**Role**

Senior Implementation Manager

**Location**

Remote

**Type**

Full-time

**Projects**

6–10 concurrent implementations

**Salary**

**$110K - $120K**

**Posted**

October 28, 2026

**About Balto**

Balto builds AI for contact centers. We help agents in the moment, score every call so leaders don’t have to, and show teams what their customers are really saying, all in one place.

***Full-Time, Remote, U.S. Only***

**About the role**

As a Senior Implementation Manager, you’ll lead complex customer implementations from kickoff through go-live. You’ll bring together executives, business owners, IT teams, and Balto partners around the outcomes customers want to achieve, while ensuring the technology is configured effectively.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can move confidently between business priorities, technical decisions, and hands-on project execution.

**What you’ll own**

* Your implementations: lead 6–10 concurrent customer projects from kickoff through go-live.
* Customer outcomes: align stakeholders on clear goals, success criteria, priorities, and decisions.
* Technical delivery: guide integrations, manage risks, and keep executive sponsors informed.

**Who we’re looking for**

You’re a seasoned implementation leader who combines strong technical judgment with excellent project management and customer skills. You can organize a complex group of stakeholders, earn the confidence of senior leaders, and keep everyone focused on the outcomes that matter.

You may be a great fit if you:

* Bring clarity and direction to complex, multi-stakeholder customer projects
* Move comfortably between executive-level business conversations and technical discussions with IT
* Anticipate risks, manage competing priorities, and drive projects forward with ownership
* Build trust across Customer Success, Sales, Support, Engineering, and customer teams
* Raise the bar through strong judgment, organization, and examples others can learn from

**Key responsibilities**

**Customer outcomes and alignment**

* Define implementation objectives and measurable success criteria with customer leaders and project stakeholders
* Align executives, business owners, and IT teams around shared priorities, decisions, and responsibilities
* Keep sponsors informed of progress, risks, tradeoffs, and how the work supports business goals

**Project leadership**

* Own implementation plans, milestones, dependencies, and execution across 6–10 concurrent projects
* Lead kickoffs, working sessions, status reviews, and go-live coordination with clear next steps
* Identify blockers early, resolve competing priorities, and maintain focus on the core implementation goals

**Technical implementation**

* Guide softphone, email, chat, SMS, SSO, CRM, and call-data integrations; validate configuration and deployment
* Partner with customer IT teams, Technical Support, and Engineering to troubleshoot complex integration issues
* Lead hands-on technical troubleshooting and resolution of complex implementation challenges, including software installations, audio routing, call identification, APIs, firewalls, and integration configurations.
* Serve as a technical escalation resource, independently diagnosing issues and partnering with Engineering when additional support or development is required.

**Cross-functional execution**

* Coordinate Sales, Customer Success, Support, and Engineering for smooth handoffs and timely decisions
* Maintain accurate project records in Asana and Salesforce and communicate On Track / At Risk / Off Track / On Hold status
* Share effective approaches and technical knowledge that strengthen the implementation team
* Develop and maintain clear technical documentation, implementation procedures, and configuration guides to support consistent and scalable customer deployments.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, reduce deployment timelines, and strengthen the overall customer experience.
* Provide technical guidance and share best practices with other Implementation Managers to strengthen team capabilities.

**What you’ll bring**

**Must-haves**

* Substantial experience independently leading complex, customer-facing software implementations or solutions engagements
* Demonstrated success aligning executive, business, and technical stakeholders around customer outcomes
* Excellent project management, prioritization, risk management, and multi-project execution skills
* Confident executive communication and the ability to translate between technical and business topics
* Strong technical fluency to partner with IT and ensure software integrations are configured effectively
* Proactive ownership, sound judgment, and a track record of navigating complex customer challenges
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex software integrations, including APIs, application configurations, and technical deployment issues.
* Ability to independently navigate complex enterprise customer environments and provide technical direction to both internal teams and customer stakeholders.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with CCaaS, VoIP, contact-center platforms, or enterprise SaaS deployments
* Familiarity with APIs, JSON, SSO, CRM integrations, Salesforce, and Asana
* Experience mentoring peers or improving implementation processes through influence

### **What success looks like**

* Deliver complex customer implementations on time, with clear communication and a high level of customer satisfaction.
* Independently navigate technical challenges and resolve implementation blockers while minimizing customer disruption.
* Deliver predetermined customer outcomes and focus implementation on those goals.
* Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders and internal teams to ensure successful deployments.
* Contribute to improvements in implementation processes, documentation, and overall team effectiveness.

**Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, Vision
* 401(k)
* Unlimited PTO
* Learning Stipends

**Our hiring process**

Our process includes interviews and a required practical skills assessment. We’ll look at how you align stakeholders around customer outcomes, lead a complex implementation, communicate with executives, and navigate technical decisions.

**Why Balto**

Six values shape how we work:

* **Anchor on Success.** We start every task by picturing what success looks like, then set ambitious goals to get there.
* **Love Every Customer.** Every customer, whatever their size or complexity, should feel valued and supported.
* **Talk Things Out.** We solve problems through open, honest conversations, without the barriers of hierarchy.
* **Always Be Growing.** Everyone owns their professional development, and our culture backs them up.
* **Own the Work.** We take initiative, solve problems proactively, and produce results we’re proud of.
* **Start with Gratitude.** We recognize each other’s contributions, even in tough discussions.

Choosing Balto means joining a company where your work is meaningful, your growth is encouraged, and your contributions are valued. It’s go time.

**How to apply**

Visit **balto.ai/careers**, select See Open Roles.

**Balto is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on protected characteristics under applicable law.**

110,000 - 120,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

If yes, consider joining Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP (BT) as a **Sage HCM Implementation & Support Manager**! At BT your main responsibilities will include leading client implementations and providing ongoing functional and technical support for Sage HCM solutions.

You will also work with existing clients to troubleshoot issues, optimize their Sage HCM environments, and help them get greater value from the system.

**At this time we are only accepting applications from candidates who are located in the pacific, mountain, or central time zone, with preference given to candidates who are located in California.**

  + Schedule and facilitate user training.
  + Serve as first point of contact for questions through implementation. Once the customer is live with the software, they will transition to Customer Support and Success.

  + Troubleshooting technical issues to determine if there is a system issue, and report issues to our development team
  + Accurately document and process customer claims in appropriate systems
  + Appropriately escalate customer issues to the CA Customer Success Team Lead
  + Ensure first call resolution through problems solving and effective call handling

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. Sustainability Innovation
  
Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.

Department IS Epic
  
Shift Day (United States of America)
  
Schedule Full time
  
Weekly Hours 40
  
FTE 1
  
Employee Status Regular
  
  

* Expected Starting Pay Range $83,969.60 - $107,224.00
* Starting pay is based on experience, skills, and equity; exceptions may apply for highly qualified candidates. Additional pay (e.g., shift, on‑call, or weekend differentials) and benefits may apply. Annual pay may vary based on FTE status.

Join one of the nation's leading pediatric healthcare organizations and help shape the future of patient care through technology. As a EMR Analyst - Epic at Cincinnati Children's Hospital Medical Center, you will play a critical role in designing, optimizing, and supporting Epic Home Care solutions that improve clinical workflows, enhance the caregiver experience, and positively impact patient outcomes.
  
  
This is an opportunity for an experienced Epic professional who thrives in a collaborative environment, enjoys solving complex challenges, and is passionate about driving innovation through technology. You will serve as a strategic partner to clinical and operational leaders, lead complex initiatives, mentor team members, and help ensure our electronic medical record systems continue to support world-class patient care.
  
  
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
Build/Configuration/Release Management
  
Analyze, design, implement, and maintain complex systems that greatly improves clinical care and patient management.
  
Support system testing.
  
Document testing outcomes.
  
Drives process improvement efforts.
  
Demonstrates advanced problem solving and technical solution skills.
  
Utilize development lifecycle process, operating procedures, and documentation to implement and support system solutions.
  
Contributes to strategic planning efforts.
  
Leads strategy and innovation in applicable clinical systems training and build environments to ensure currency and usability.
  
Independently develop and mentor others on education technology content for applicable use.
  
Drive the use of multivariate learning modalities to cover the adult learning spectrum and clinical system education need.
  
  
Leadership and Mentoring
  
Take ownership of tasks with sense of urgency and drive them to completion.
  
Independent in work effort, escalating when appropriate.
  
Coordinate necessary resources and communicate impacts to the user community.
  
Collaborate with other team members to resolve issues and foster success with the customer base.
  
Serves as a mentor when working through details of a problem to reach a positive solution.
  
Set strategy and vision to support a user base through clinical system training and the creation and curation of expert education and training materials.
  
Strategize with end users to ensure that clinical system applications and accompanying training programs and materials remain current and support patient care delivery processes.
  
Network with internal and external experts to identify best practices for clinical system use and training.
  
Promote use of industry best practice tools for efficiency and innovative education and learning.
  
  
Professional Growth & Development
  
Maintain currency in the field by participating in educational opportunities provided by vendor and other customer connections.
  
Conduct and participate in instructional sessions.
  
Use knowledge to improve skills.
  
Develop and maintain positive relationships, both internal and external to CCHMC.
  
Motivate people and encourage teamwork.
  
Work well with others and fosters a positive team environment.
  
Use knowledge to drive innovation.
  
Prepare oral and written presentations.
  
  
Project Management
  
Lead the design, development, and implementation of new and enhanced EMR requests.
  
Develop and manage project plans and other project-related documentation for complex projects.
  
Manages multiple moderate to complex projects independently.
  
Determine the scope of complex projects.
  
Coordinate the appropriate resources needed.
  
Independently prioritize assigned tasks and projects.
  
Coordinate and facilitate communication between internal and external parties on assigned tasks and related issues.
  
Independently works with cross functional teams to ensure proper integration.
  
Consult with and support the end user community to develop and validate requirements for system solutions.
  
Work with 3rd-party developers to review potential software development solutions for integrated build issues.
  
  
Manage Customer Relationships
  
Develop collaborative professional relationships with customer group and key stakeholders.
  
Ensure outstanding end-user support is provided, including ongoing monitoring of Service Level Agreements for incident management and collaboration with other areas to ensure customer-centered incident management and support.
  
Plan, execute, and support a user base through clinical system training and the creation and curation of expert education and training materials.
  
Adhere to and promote continual adoption of change management policies and procedures.
  
Strong sense of personal accountability.
  
Model outstanding customer service behavior, including timely and effective follow-up with customers.
  
Always maintain CCHMC's service standards of being Courteous, Attentive, Respectful and Enthusiastic team members, and Safe (CARES).
  
  
JOB QUALIFICATIONS
  
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
  
2+ years of work experience in a related job discipline
  
  
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
Epic certification in the supported application(s) is preferred. If not certified at the time of hire, certification is required within six (6) months of the start date.
  
Epic Build/Maintenance experience.
  
Advanced problem-solving skills.
  
Critical thinking skills.
  
Ability to work independently.
  
  
About Us
  
  
**At Cincinnati Children’s, we come to work with one goal:** to make children’s health better. We believe in a holistic team approach, both in caring for patients and their families, and in advancing science and discovery. We strive to do better and find energy and inspiration in our shared purpose. If you want to be the best you can be, you can do it at Cincinnati Children’s.
  
  
**Cincinnati Children's is:**  
Recognized by U.S. News & World Report as a top 10 best Children's Hospitals in the nation for more than 15 years
  
  
Consistently among the top 3 Children's Hospitals for National Institutes of Health (NIH) Funding
  
  
Recognized as one of America’s Best Large Employers (2025) , America’s Best Employers for New Grads (2025)
  
  
One of the nation's America’s Most Innovative Companies as noted by Fortune
  
  
Consistently certified as great place to work
  
  
A Leading Disability Employer as noted by the National Organization on Disability
  
  
Magnet® designated for the fourth consecutive time by the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC)
  
  
 We Embrace Innovation—Together. We believe in empowering our teams with the tools that help us work smarter and care better. That’s why we support the responsible use of artificial intelligence. By encouraging innovation, we’re creating space for new ideas, better outcomes, and a stronger future—for all of us.
  
Comprehensive job description provided upon request.

jobs.title: Max Training Specialist
jobs.description:
QubicaAMF has an exciting opportunity as a Max Training Specialist in the training department. This position ensures the maximum effectiveness of company products, business practices, and other related topics and services by implementing product training for customers and end-users of QubicaAMF products, primarily focusing on STS (Scoring and Technology Solutions) related products.

### **Essential Functions/Compentencies**

* Provides product and technical training for different scoring software and related products offered by QubicaAMF to customers and other end-users in a one-to-one or small group setting.
* Travels to the jobsite and conducts on-site product training for customers.
* Conducts customer interviews and utilizes experience and judgment to design appropriate training agendas for each customer.
* Delivers consultative style training designed to help customers retain more learning and utilize products to their fullest potential.
* Provides training support for customers after the initial training has been completed. Responds to inquiries concerning product operations and execution.
* Interfaces between customers and technical support, Project Management, Installation Teams, and other related departments to assist in identifying issues and implementing corrective actions to help find resolutions for the customer.
* Utilizes Microsoft CRM to upload customer data and reports, training summaries, and research customer technical issues.
* May install or assist service personnel with the installation, service, or support of different products offered by QubicaAMF.
* Provides updates, status reports, and completion information to the manager, Technical Support Team, and Project Management team via voicemail, email, or in-person communication.
* Identifies and tracks problems and customer-related issues with the manager when needed or required.
* Assists in the development of training tools for new products and services.
* Participates in training sessions.
* Relies on instructions and pre-established guidelines to perform the job functions.
* Other duties may be assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

* The position will not have direct reports.

Competencies/Qualifications

* Knowledge of commonly used training concepts, practices, and procedures. Software Field Training experience preferred.
* Total commitment to customer satisfaction and service.
* Expert problem solver and solution finder.
* Ability to translate technical knowledge into plain, easy-to-understand language for the end user.
* Willingness to take on any challenge, big or small.
* Proficient in Microsoft Windows and Office products. Good working knowledge of Microsoft CRM.
* Knowledge of basic computer networking configuration and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with Qubica AMF automatic scoring and management systems, plus

Work Environment

* Varies due to the location of the job assignment.

Physical Demands

* The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, use hands, fingers, handle, or feel, and
* reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.

Travel Required

* Travel will be up to 80% of the job requirements.
* Available to work after hours, weekends, on-call, and odd shifts as required.

Required Education and Experience

* Associate’s degree, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience in bowling center operations or bowling equipment preferred.

Competitive compensation and benefits include medical/dental/vision insurance, 401k with employer contribution, PTO, paid Holidays, and an on-site fitness center.
